s1.desc: a bedroom with a yellow bed and a nightstand with a peach lamp

spans.notes: Pax asleep in bed. Slow push-in that eases out: headboard fit vs f59 gives scale 1.016 at f20, 1.009 at f30, 1.005 at f34, 1.003 at f37, 1.000 from f38 (identity overlap 0.29 -> 0.92). compare f0/f59 shows the whole bed doubled. shot_review and keep12 (steady run [0,61]) called it static

spans.view: with fluffy pillows and a duck-shaped bedpost

beats.text: Pax lies asleep under the blanket with his eyes closed and his beak open in a snore
Pax snaps his eyes wide open and stares straight up, startled
Pax squeezes his eyes shut and starts to push himself up out of bed

spans.notes: headboard and lamp fit f38 vs f59/f60: identity 0.914-0.920 = best fit (no scale or shift); compare f38/f60 edges overlap. The footboard bobs 2-4 px up and down while the headboard holds still, read as bed animation, not camera. Only 23 frames (one f21 window). Pax is ~16% of the height | verification 2026-10-26: push-in continues to f50 (+~1%) then snaps back f50-53; static only f53-60
Pax leaps out of bed and lands beside it while the view slides right to follow him (bed shifts ~23 px per frame at f61-67, easing to 6 px at f87); compare f70/f83 shows the bedpost and lamp doubled
verification pass 2 (verify2_report_0): last frame of the pan right (bed and lamp 2 px off the locked position); merge into the preceding camera_move span so it becomes [61,89)

spans.view: with the foot of the bed in front of him

beats.text: Pax leans over the bed with his eyes squeezed shut, then straightens up beside it
Pax stands at the bedside smoothing the blanket flat with quick strokes of one flipper, glancing ahead
Pax turns to face forward and squeezes his eyes shut
Pax rubs both eyes hard with his flippers

spans.notes: bedpost, lamp and footboard fit f88-f145: identity overlap 0.997-1.000 from f88 on (compare f88/f145). Ends at f125, where Polly first shows | verification pass 2 (verify2_report_0): the pan-right before this span is still easing out at f88: phase correlation on the headboard, lamp and footboard gives f87 -9.5 px, f88 -2.15 px, f89 onward 0.00 px vs f89/f124 (three separate ROIs agree). Lock starts at f89.

Pax lowers his flippers and stands up straight with wide eyes, while the top of Polly's head rises up from the bottom-right edge (only the dome and tuft visible). Dropped because Polly is only a sliver: listing her would caption her as a full penguin coming in, and leaving her out would be false. Conservative drop of a 21-frame piece
